newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Bank Ukraina to seek 10 mln dlr credit.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Bank Ukraina to seek 10 mln dlr credit.

text.p: LONDON, January 30 (LPC) - Bank Ukraina has mandated Raiffelson Zentral Bank to arrange a $10 million trade financing credit, according to a banker close to the deal.
This is believed to be the first time that a Ukrainian company has sought funds through the syndicated loan market.
The six month credit is sought for export and import purposes and is due to launch into general syndication next week.
Bank Ukraina is one of Ukraine's five largest banks. The EBRD is currently considering buying a stake of up to 20 per cent in the bank.
